entries.title: Loading most recent iNaturalist Data
entries.summary: Expanded the production dataset from approximately 40 million to 71 million records.
methodology: Loaded the latest machine annotated images from iNaturalist photos into the production search index.
Rebuilt the index used by the Phenobase interface queries.
Verified that datasource, decade, family, genus, and mapped-trait aggregations completed after the load.
changes: Increased the searchable record count available in the interface.
Updated the global stats overview to reflect the expanded dataset.
Confirmed that the public interface continued querying the production index after the refresh.

changes: Published the 22.9 million records to the public interface.
